fields.label: iter14: 2 pool-free guards C2->C3
fields.value: Commit 527be742. 0x005ae380 + 0x005ad8b0, guarded pool-free wrappers. Extended reg_this_call_observe with a this_reg='stack' __cdecl trampoline; stubbing the callee was the only safe route because the pool anchor is a hardcoded immediate, so a real call would hand a fabricated node to the LIVE allocator. Recording the stub's arg0 checks branch AND anchor at once. Third sibling 0x005a6c90 held INCONCLUSIVE — degenerate, cause not established, not promoted on its siblings' strength.

fields.label: Harness bug fixed (had RED'd 3 correct ports)
fields.value: reg_this_call_observe recorded 'callee not invoked' as null and required both sides non-null to match, so null==null read as a mismatch. For a guarded call, 'not invoked' IS the observation of the taken branch. Now a 'not-called' sentinel counted in both the match test and the distinct-value check.
